facts.fact: Starlink is not licensed in Libya: talks with the regulator GACI, open since 2024 on services, licensing structure, frequencies and coverage, had reached no agreement and were on hold until further notice as of the article's date, per GACI sources.

Eutelsat OneWeb is sold in Libya through a multi-year exclusive distribution agreement with a Libyan local partner, extended to LEO connectivity from early 2024, for oil and gas, telecoms, finance, government and humanitarian customers.
